definitions.rationale: Expands the nullary parseMusicBody proof term into the exact function-body AST; it is a named syntax definition and does not replace an executing K configuration.
definitions.text:
rule parseMusicBody =>
    Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
    Assign(Name("current"), Int(0))
    For(Name("char"), Name("music_string"), parseMusicCharBody)
    If(Compare(Name("current"), CmpOp("==", Int(4))),
       Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("current") , .Exprs)) .Stmts,
       .Stmts)
    Return(Name("result"))

definitions.rationale: Expands parseMusicCharBody into the character-processing statement AST, so it defines a named proof term rather than asserting an additional fact or operational shortcut.
definitions.text:
rule parseMusicCharBody =>
    If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str("o"))),
       Assign(Name("current"), Int(4)) .Stmts,
       If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str("."))),
          Assign(Name("current"), Int(1)) .Stmts,
          If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str("|"))),
             If(Compare(Name("current"), CmpOp("==", Int(4))),
                Assign(Name("current"), Int(2)) .Stmts,
                .Stmts)
             Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("current") , .Exprs))
             Assign(Name("current"), Int(0)),
             If(Compare(Name("current"), CmpOp("==", Int(4))),
                Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("current") , .Exprs)) .Stmts,
                .Stmts)
             Assign(Name("current"), Int(0)))))

definitions.rationale: Expands the validation-only mutatedParseMusicCharBody term into the deliberately changed character-body AST and therefore defines syntax rather than program execution.
definitions.text:
rule mutatedParseMusicCharBody =>
    If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str("o"))),
       Assign(Name("current"), Int(5)) .Stmts,
       If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str("."))),
          Assign(Name("current"), Int(1)) .Stmts,
          If(Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str("|"))),
             If(Compare(Name("current"), CmpOp("==", Int(4))),
                Assign(Name("current"), Int(2)) .Stmts,
                .Stmts)
             Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("current") , .Exprs))
             Assign(Name("current"), Int(0)),
             If(Compare(Name("current"), CmpOp("==", Int(4))),
                Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("current") , .Exprs)) .Stmts,
                .Stmts)
             Assign(Name("current"), Int(0)))))

definitions.rationale: Defines the nextCurrent state-transition function for character code 111 by returning the pending whole-note value 4.
Defines the nextCurrent state-transition function for character code 46 by returning the pending quarter-note value 1.
Defines the complementary nextCurrent case, resetting the pending value when the character is neither 111 nor 46.
definitions.text:
rule nextCurrent(C:Int, _:Int) => 0
    requires C =/=Int 111 andBool C =/=Int 46

definitions.rationale: Defines the nextResult transition for a pipe following pending value 4 by appending the half-note value 2.
definitions.text:
rule nextResult(ACC:ValSeq, C:Int, CUR:Int)
    => valSeqConcat(ACC, vCons(2, .ValSeq))
    requires C ==Int 124 andBool CUR ==Int 4

definitions.rationale: Defines the nextResult transition for a pipe with a pending value other than 4 by appending that pending value.
definitions.text:
rule nextResult(ACC:ValSeq, C:Int, CUR:Int)
    => valSeqConcat(ACC, vCons(CUR, .ValSeq))
    requires C ==Int 124 andBool CUR =/=Int 4

definitions.rationale: Defines the nextResult transition that flushes a pending whole note when a non-note, non-pipe separator is encountered.
definitions.text:
rule nextResult(ACC:ValSeq, C:Int, CUR:Int)
    => valSeqConcat(ACC, vCons(4, .ValSeq))
    requires C =/=Int 111 andBool C =/=Int 46 andBool C =/=Int 124
     andBool CUR ==Int 4

definitions.rationale: Defines the complementary nextResult no-append cases, completing the guarded state-transition function.
definitions.text:
rule nextResult(ACC:ValSeq, C:Int, CUR:Int) => ACC
    requires (C ==Int 111 orBool C ==Int 46)
      orBool (C =/=Int 124 andBool CUR =/=Int 4)

definitions.rationale: Defines the base case of the scanCurrent recurrence on an empty character-code sequence.
Defines the structurally recursive scanCurrent step by consuming one code and recurring on the strict tail.
definitions.text:
rule scanCurrent(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), CUR:Int)
    => scanCurrent(REST, nextCurrent(C, CUR))

definitions.rationale: Defines the base case of the scanResult recurrence by returning the accumulated value sequence.
Defines the structurally recursive scanResult step using the already defined one-character state transitions.
definitions.text:
rule scanResult(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), CUR:Int, ACC:ValSeq)
    => scanResult(REST, nextCurrent(C, CUR), nextResult(ACC, C, CUR))

definitions.rationale: Defines musicResult when scanning ends with pending value 4 by appending the final whole-note duration.
definitions.text:
rule musicResult(CS:IntSeq)
    => valSeqConcat(scanResult(CS, 0, .ValSeq), vCons(4, .ValSeq))
    requires scanCurrent(CS, 0) ==Int 4

definitions.rationale: Defines the complementary musicResult case by returning scanResult when no final whole-note flush is required.
